widgets_values:
masterpiece, best quality, ultra detailed, extremely detailed, 8k uhd, highres, absurdres,
anime game environment, game scene background, in-game location concept,
by genshin impact art team, by wuthering waves art team, official game promotional environment art,
cel-shaded painting, hard shadow shading, vibrant game palette, painterly anime background,

=== SCENE TYPE ===
ancient overgrown ruins of a wind god temple, nestled in a misty mountain valley,
a worn stone pathway leading through crumbling archways toward a central sanctuary,
glowing wind crystals embedded in the ground marking a trail,
sacred tree at the center with translucent floating leaves,
broken bridge on the right side connecting to a collapsed tower,
a small offering shrine with lit candles and a stone bowl of crystal water,

=== ARCHITECTURE ===
celtic-inspired fantasy temple ruins, weathered sandstone blocks with moss-filled cracks,
ornate pillar stumps carved with wind motif reliefs,
semicircular arches partially collapsed, some still holding vine-covered lintels,
stone staircase descending into an underground chamber visible on the left,
intricate floor tile patterns partially exposed through overgrown grass,
a circular ritual platform with carved runes glowing faint teal,
wooden bridge planks over a chasm on the right, ropes frayed but intact,

=== VEGETATION & PROPS ===
giant ancient tree with twisted trunk, sprawling roots breaking through stone,
translucent pale green leaves with soft glow, floating petals caught in upward draft,
climbing vines and ivy wrapping around every column and wall,
clusters of blue glowing mushrooms along the path edges (game item nodes),
tall mountain grass swaying, scattered wildflowers in purple and white,
a small wooden chest half-hidden behind a pillar (game interactable),
wind chimes made of crystal shards hanging from branches,
floating rocks suspended in the air near the central tree, anti-gravity effect,

=== LIGHTING ===
primary light source: soft diffused daylight from above, overcast mountain sky,
secondary: teal-green glow from wind crystals and runes on the ground,
ambient: pale green mist filling lower areas, atmospheric depth gradient,
god rays filtering through tree canopy creating dappled light on the path,
strong rim light on the central tree and floating rocks, silhouette glow,
warm candle glow from the offering shrine, small warm light pool,
shadow areas are soft and blue-green, not pure black — game-friendly visibility,
overall flat-ish lighting with clear value separation for gameplay readability,
no harsh contrast — everything remains visible and navigable,

=== COMPOSITION ===
game environment establishing shot, eye-level player perspective,
central path leading the eye from foreground to the sanctuary — strong leading lines,
foreground: broken archway frame and path edge crystals, slight depth of field blur,
midground: main temple area with tree, platform, and shrine — sharp focus,
background: mountain valley and distant floating islands fading into mist,
asymmetrical balance with tree on center-right and collapsed tower on left,
path curves gently to create exploration intrigue — what's around the bend?
framing: foliage and archway on the edges creating natural vignette,
wide 16:9 or 2:1 panoramic composition for game environment showcase,

=== ATMOSPHERE ===
sacred and serene, a forgotten place of worship reclaimed by nature,
gentle wind always present, petals and leaves drifting upward,
mystical teal-green energy permeating the air near the central tree,
soft mountain fog rolling in from the valley,
a sense of ancient power dormant but not gone,
color palette: warm sandstone beige, teal-green glow, soft purple shadows, white highlights,
mood: peaceful exploration, wonder, quiet mystery, no danger felt,

=== GAME STYLE ===
genshin impact environment art style, wuthering waves scene painting,
cel-shaded architecture with painted texture details,
vibrant but slightly desaturated colors, no photorealism,
clean readable silhouettes for all interactive objects,
pbr-lite material rendering, hand-painted texture feel,
stylized shadows with soft edges, no harsh contact shadows,
subsurface glow on vegetation and crystals,
game-optimized detail density — more detail near path, less in distance,
official game location art quality, screenshot-ready composition
